summary: Iteration 5: Verified dark cinematic auth redesign + horizontal Shanghai hero + dashboard theme toggle. Backend regression PASS (2/2 pytest, all critical auth+CRUD+2FA+forgot/reset flows). Frontend PASS on all 15 review-request bullets: hero uses cb3hdfee_hori.png with cover + Ken Burns, auth aside 58% (835px @1440) at x=0/y=0 with h5p5wtvy_SecureFin_cityscape_4K.webp on ::before, auth main 42% at x~835/y=0, cinematic entrance animations (authImageIn/authImageDrift/authOverlayIn/authMainIn/authCardIn/authCopyIn) all present, admin login → /app OK, registration path OK via backend test, eye toggle correct convention (EyeOff when type=password → Eye when type=text), forgot-password link visible/clickable in dark card, theme toggle applies body.light + persists in localStorage 'securefin-theme' across reload, light mode contrast readable (stat-card #1a1235 on #fff, sidebar 0.75 white, H1 dark ink), dark accents intact, 9 sidebar routes navigate in both themes, mobile 375 stacks with no horizontal overflow, prefers-reduced-motion collapses image/overlay/main/card animations. No console JS errors (only expected 401 on /api/auth/me for unauthenticated landing).

tests_executed.hero_horizontal: PASS - .hero-city-img backgroundImage contains cb3hdfee_hori.png, background-size:cover, animation-name:heroKenBurns, .hero-city-veil present
tests_executed.cinematic_animations: PASS - ::before animation-name='authImageIn, authImageDrift'; ::after 'authOverlayIn'; .auth-main 'authMainIn'; .auth-card 'authCardIn'; .auth-card-head 'authCopyIn'. Final state opacity=1 / transform=none as expected
tests_executed.password_eye_toggle: PASS - type=password renders .lucide-eye-off; click .auth-password-toggle (data-testid=toggle-password-visibility) → type=text renders .lucide-eye (no eye-off)
tests_executed.forgot_password: PASS - data-testid='forgot-password-link' button present and clickable on dark card
tests_executed.theme_toggle: PASS - default body className has no 'light' + ls='dark'; click theme-toggle → body.light + ls='light'; reload keeps 'light'; click again → 'dark'
tests_executed.light_mode_contrast: PASS - stat-card text rgb(26,18,53) on rgb(255,255,255); sidebar text rgb(26,18,53) on rgba(255,255,255,0.75); H1 rgb(26,18,53) — high contrast
tests_executed.sidebar_9_routes_dark: PASS - /app (Good evening), /app/transactions, /app/investments, /app/subscriptions, /app/budgets, /app/analytics, /app/security, /app/profile, /app/settings all render correct H1
tests_executed.sidebar_routes_light: PASS - same routes render correctly in light mode
tests_executed.responsive_375: PASS - aside/main stack vertically, documentElement.scrollWidth == window.innerWidth (no horizontal overflow)
tests_executed.reduced_motion: PASS - all auth entrance animations respect prefers-reduced-motion:reduce (global *,*::before,*::after 0.001ms rule applies)
tests_executed.console_errors: PASS - only benign /api/auth/me 401 on unauth pages; no JS exceptions

critical_code_review_comments: Auth cinematic layer stack looks correct — ::before (image + drift), ::after (overlay gradient), > * (z-index:2) for content. Nicely done.
Note (already flagged in iter 4): App.js still monolithic; not a regression but worth modularising when time permits.

Small nit: sidebar visually shows 7 top-level nav items; Profile/Settings appear to be reached via avatar/menu — routes exist and render but not directly in sidebar. Matches previous iterations, not a new regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three requested changes verified live at https://money-vault-89.preview.emergentagent.com : (1) landing hero uses horizontal cb3hdfee_hori.png; (2) /auth is dark cinematic 58/42 split with h5p5wtvy_SecureFin_cityscape_4K.webp on aside ::before + 5 staggered entrance keyframes; (3) sidebar data-testid='theme-toggle' swaps body.light class and persists in localStorage 'securefin-theme'. Backend endpoints unchanged and green. No action required.
